tweets.text: Duet Night Abyss — new story commission live now. Dive in, clear stages, and grab those rewards!
Weekly known issues update: we’re working on co-op homing arrows and summon attribute inheritance. Thanks for your patience.
Event reminder: Rainbow-coloured Dream continues this week. Don’t forget to claim Secret Letter rewards.
Patch note highlights: fixed Secret Letter sources, resolved duplicated UI in event screens, and reissued missing clues via in-game mail.
Co-op commissions: we’re monitoring feedback around bulk selling fish UI and will ship improvements soon.
